text:
maggie: Quick sync — Initiative Strata needs cross-team sequencing. Product has 3 customer-driven asks that change runtime e2e behavior + infra quotas + a short security review. Can owners confirm minimal gating and rough lead times by EOD Thu?

diego: Agree — summary: (1) per-tenant burst slots, (2) deterministic tail latency <=120ms P95, (3) auditable key usage for model weights.

sam: For runtime: need QPS shape (spiky vs steady) and target max tokens/session. Do we expect heavy long-context usage?

diego: Customers will send short prompts mostly, with occasional 4k contexts for retrieval. Plan: optimize for short-requests, fall back to 4k-capable path for known tenants.

carla: Infra questions: reserved GPU pool required? if so, what size/region. Also need a prewarm strategy if we want stable P95.

sam: Proposed runtime plan: use quantized 8-bit variant for short paths, full FP16 for 4k. Prewarm warmup=2 for pool items, continuous batching enabled.

carla: If we reserve, estimate minimum: 2x A10 per 100 sustained QPS for short requests. If can tolerate burst to shared pool, reservation can be 1x A10 and auto-burst.

ira: Security: key-usage audit needs KMS integration + access logs. If model artifacts are encrypted with customer keys, we need HSM/KMS ticket and SRE runbook for rotation. Timeline for security review is ~3 business days once we have architecture doc.

maggie: Good to know. Let's make the minimal gating: 1) runtime perf profile for sample tenant at 50 QPS, 2) infra reservation plan (region + size + fallback), 3) security checklist (KMS/roles/audit). If those three exist, product can greenlight canary.

diego: I'll assemble a short 'launch corridor' doc and include acceptance criteria. Will post link in thread.

ci-bot: <https://redwood.docs/strata/launch-corridor|Docs: Strata launch corridor> (draft) — contains perf harness and sample traffic generator.

sam: Quick note on perf harness: use this command locally to simulate tenant load:
```
./perf-run --model strata-q8 --qps 50 --session_tokens 50 --duration 10m
```
This will emit latency histogram to /tmp/strata-latency.json. Share results in thread.

carla: I'll validate capacity numbers and reply with region/sku by EOD Wed. If we need strict P95 SLA, we'll recommend dedicated capacity.

ira: Add to security checklist: encrypted at rest, KMS usage logs forwarded to central SIEM, scoped service account for runtime, documented key rotation policy. I can start a pre-review once diego publishes architecture.

diego: Draft posted — will ping all. Action owners: diego (product doc + customer criteria), sam (perf harness + runtime config), carla (infra sizing + fallback), ira (security checklist + pre-review). Proposed dates: doc by Tue EOD, infra numbers Wed EOD, perf runs Thu AM, full signoff Thu EOD.

maggie: Perfect. If any blockers on timelines speak up now. Also note: fallback model variant must be compatible with current API signatures to avoid product changes.

sam: Noted — I'll ensure model shims keep same API. If quantized variant shows regressions on quality, we'll route to small-hosted model as fallback.

carla: FYI: cost estimate for dedicated reservation ~ $X/day per A10 (will provide precise). If product accepts some cold-start risk we can save 30-40% by relying on shared pool.

diego: Product tradeoff — we'll weigh cost vs P95 risk in doc. Thanks everyone, will update thread when doc is live. :thumbsup:
